{{Infobox Mechanic |image= {{Media |Sprite BotW= File:BotW Defense Up Icon.png |Sprite TotK= File:TotK Defense Up Icon.png |Sprite EoW= File:EoW Damage Reduced Icon.png }} |caption= |pronunciation= |game= BotW, TotK |other= |purpose= |related= {{List| * [[Added Effect]] * [[Cooking]] * [[Damage Reduced +]] * [[Defense]] }} }} {{Term/Store|Damage Reduced||Series, EoW}},{{Exp Game|EoW}} also known as {{Term/Store|Defense Up||BotW, TotK}},{{Exp Game|BotW, TotK}} and '''Damage Reduction''',{{Exp Game|EoW}} is a recurring [[Added Effect]] in {{TLoZ Series}}. ==Overview== ==={{BotW|-}} and {{TotK|-}}=== In {{BotW}} and {{TotK}}, Defense Up is an [[Added Effect]] that increases [[Link]]'s [[Defense]] by 4, 12, and 24 for levels one, two, and three respectively. It has a max potency of level three, and it can be acquired by consuming [[Meal]]s or [[Elixir]]s made with: {{Gallery List|Items |TotK= Ironshroom, Fortified Pumpkin, Armoranth, Armored Carp, Armored Porgy, Ironshell Crab, Rugged Rhino Beetle }} ==={{EoW|-}}=== Damage Reduced is an [[Added Effect]] that decreases the amount of damage the [[Princess Zelda]] takes when she is attacked by an [[Enemy]]. It can be obtained by equipping the [[Ancient Charm]]. Zelda can also temporarily activate the Effect by drinking [[Smoothie]]s or [[Potion]]s with "Tough" in their names, which are made using [[Tough Mango]]es. An upgraded version of this Effect, [[Damage Reduced +]], can be obtained by wearing the [[Curious Charm]].
